lines.en: label iodorm25:
I knock on Io’s door and wait for her to answer, but my patience is quickly met by the sounds of the half-hushed humming of an unfamiliar tune halfway between heartbreak and harmony.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Io 的门等她来应门，可我的耐心很快就被一阵压得低低的哼唱声接了过去——那是一支陌生的曲子，介于心碎与和声之间。

lines.en: I do not know what has broken from this side of the door. But if there is anything I know about Io, it is that she likely has the tools to fix it.
lines.zh: 我不知道门这一边到底什么东西碎了。但倘若我对 Io 还有一点了解，那就是——她大概有工具能把它修好。

lines.en: I knock again so she knows it’s me.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次，好让她知道是我。

lines.en: The humming stops and her attention bounces from whatever undeserving plank of wood it previously settled on and back to me where it rightfully belongs.
lines.zh: 哼唱停了下来，她的注意力从之前落点的那块不配的木板上一跃而起，回到我身上——它本该在那儿。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Yup. Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 嗯。我能进来吗？

lines.en: : I don’t knooooooww~ You might be kind of boooooored...
lines.zh: : 我不——知——道——哦~ 你可能会有点无——聊——哦……

lines.en: Her words are slurred, something I couldn’t pick up from the humming, but the vulnerable state of an already vulnerable girl is not something that would force me back the way it would force others.
lines.zh: 她说话含混不清——这一点我从哼唱里听不出来——可一个本就脆弱的女孩露出这副脆弱的样子，并不会像逼退别人那样把我逼退。

lines.en: scene black
It just brings me closer.
lines.zh: 它只会让我靠得更近。

lines.en: scene iooutofit1
What I’m closer {i}to{/i} is something I’m not sure of, though.
lines.zh: 不过，我到底是在靠近{i}什么{/i}，我自己也说不准。

lines.en: It’s not heartbreak for the remnants of my cardiovascular system have been worn so thin that “breaking” wouldn’t even suffice in describing the severing of the bits that are left at this point.
lines.zh: 不是心碎——因为我心血管系统的残余部分已经被磨得这么薄，到了这一步，光说「碎」都不足以形容剩下那些碎片的断裂。

lines.en: It’s not harmony either as the two of us inside of this room are almost constantly acting in opposition to whatever the world would have us do to move in unison.
lines.zh: 也不是和声——因为这屋里我们两个，几乎一直在跟世界要求我们做出的整齐划一背道而驰。

lines.en: I’m just closer to {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 我只是离{i}她{/i}更近了。

lines.en: Whether that’s good for either of us is something that remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 这对我们俩到底是不是好事，还有待观察。

lines.en: But, if you want my opinion-
lines.zh: 不过，如果你要听我的意见——

lines.en: The only thing that would be good for us is if we were left alone and stopped forcing ourselves to find one another.
lines.zh: 对我们唯一有益的，就是让彼此独处，别再逼着自己去寻找对方。

lines.en: : Heeeeey. Io Ichimonji here, reporting live from the floor. Which is coincidentally exactly where she belongs.
lines.zh: : 嘿——呀。我是 Io Ichimonji，正在地板上为您现场报道。而地板恰好也正是她该待的地方。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’d call this “boring,” Io.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这能不能叫「无聊」，Io。

lines.en: : Well, hey! If me being hopped on a medicinal cocktail’s enough to keep you entertained, you might be in for the most exciting night of your life.
lines.zh: : 嘿，话是这么说！如果我嗑了一顿药物鸡尾酒就能让你看得下去，那你今晚可能会迎来人生中最刺激的一夜。

lines.en: : Just kind of figured I wouldn’t be as much fun as normal when every word I speak brings me one step closer to passing out.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我说的每个字都让我离昏过去更近一步，大概就没平时那么好玩了。

lines.en: : But then again, I’m not really any fun to begin with. So your taste is already kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我本来就不怎么好玩。所以你的品味本来就挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Anyway, how’re things? Your niece still number one in the harem ranking? Uta says she makes a mean omurice.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，最近怎么样？你侄女在后宫排行里还是第一吗？Uta 说她做的蛋包饭一绝。

lines.en: : If talking is bringing you closer to passing out, maybe it’s best if you just...you know, don’t do that?
lines.zh: : 要是说话会让你离昏过去更近，也许你最好就……你知道的，别说话了？

lines.en: : But then you’d {i}really{/i} be bored. And it’s not like I’m actually {i}gonna{/i} pass out. I’m just getting {i}closer{/i} to passing out.
lines.zh: : 可那样你才是{i}真的{/i}无聊了。而且我又不{i}会{/i}真的昏过去。我只是离昏过去{i}更近{/i}了而已。

lines.en: : As if I’d waste this precious time with my favorite person in the world on {i}sleeping{/i} when he’s already expressed that he’s cool with me over-medicating myself.
lines.zh: : 他都说过对我用药过量没意见了，我怎么可能把和这世上我最喜欢的人在一起的宝贵时间浪费在{i}睡觉{/i}上。

lines.en: : I’m not “cool” with that. You’re kind of weirding me out right now, actually. But at least you don’t look like you’re on the verge of dying this time.
lines.zh: : 我对那件事可没「没意见」。说实话你现在让我有点发毛。不过至少这次你看上去不像快死了。

lines.en: : Different pills, different side effects. The endless cycle of targeted drug usage to combat the many things wrong with this stupid brain of mine.
lines.zh: : 不同的药，不同的副作用。用靶向药物去对付我这颗蠢脑子的一大堆毛病——无休无止的循环。

lines.en: : And what exactly were you targeting this time?
lines.zh: : 那这次你靶向的是什么？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Why’s it matter what I was targeting? Can’t we just pretend that I’m feeling completely normal so we can have a completely normal conversation?
lines.zh: : 我靶向什么有那么重要吗？我们就不能假装我现在感觉完全正常，好进行一场完全正常的对话吗？

lines.en: : Is any conversation with you completely normal?
lines.zh: : 跟你的对话有哪次是完全正常的？

lines.en: : No. I like you too much to be able to speak normally. I’ll just wind up messing up again.
lines.zh: : 没有。我太喜欢你了，没法正常说话。最后只会又搞砸。

lines.en: : Can I help you up? Or do you want to stay down there on the floor?
lines.zh: : 要我扶你起来吗？还是你想就这么待在地上？

lines.en: : Wait wait wait. I just had the best idea.
lines.zh: : 等等等等。我刚想到一个绝妙的主意。

lines.en: : I somehow doubt that.
lines.zh: : 我对此表示怀疑。

lines.en: : No no no. Hear me out.
lines.zh: : 不不不。听我说完。

lines.en: : If things can’t be normal because of how fucked up I am right now...
lines.zh: : 既然因为我现在的状况太糟糕，事情没法正常……

lines.en: scene iooutofit2
: You just need to get fucked up too!
lines.zh: : 那你也把自己弄糟糕就行了！

lines.en: : How is that “the best” idea? That’s a horrible idea.
lines.zh: : 这怎么就是「绝妙」的主意了？这是个烂主意。

lines.en: : Why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you very clearly need someone to look after you.
lines.zh: : 因为很明显你需要有人照顾你。

lines.en: scene iooutofit3
: Nuh-uh. I know my limits when it comes to treating myself. Do I intentionally push those limits sometimes? Hell yeah. But this isn’t one of those times.
lines.zh: : 才不要。给自己用药这方面，我知道自己的极限。我有时候会故意去推那个极限吗？当然会。但这次不是。

lines.en: : I promise this is like, normal loopiness. The kind of stuff you’d be dealing with at least three nights a week if you ever ran away with me.
lines.zh: : 我保证这就是普通的晕乎。要是你哪天跟我私奔了，一周至少有三个晚上得应付这种状况。

lines.en: : If it was {i}really{/i} bad, I’d be hunched over my stepladder again and you’d have to carry me over to the kotatsu. But look! I made it here all by myself this time! Woohoo!
lines.zh: : 要是{i}真的{/i}很糟，我早就又趴在小梯子上了，你得把我扛到暖桌那边去。可你看！这次我是自己走到这儿的！呜呼！

lines.en: : Either way, I’m not taking any of your pills.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我不会吃你的任何药。

lines.en: : Why not? They might help you.
lines.zh: : 为什么？它们说不定对你有帮助。

lines.en: : I don’t need help.
lines.zh: : 我不需要帮助。

lines.en: : Wish I could think that way.
lines.zh: : 真希望我也能这么想。

lines.en: : Either way, I wasn’t talking about pills in the first place. They’re too expensive and I like them too much to share.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我一开始说的也不是药。它们太贵了，而且我太喜欢它们，舍不得分给别人。

lines.en: : What {i}were{/i} you talking about then?
lines.zh: : 那你说的{i}到底{/i}是什么？

lines.en: scene iooutofit4
: One of our regular customers gifted us a bottle of sake a while back that I was supposed to give to my aunt- but I never did because I’m an asshole.
lines.zh: : 前阵子有个常客送了我们一瓶清酒，我本来该交给我姑姑的——可我没交，因为我是个混蛋。

lines.en: : Also, I thought it would be a fun thing to have in case Uta and I ever got bored one night. But it’s been here ever since and neither one of us has ever touched it.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得留着挺有意思的，万一哪天晚上 Uta 和我无聊了呢。可它从那以后就一直在这儿，我们俩谁都没碰过。

lines.en: scene iooutofit5
: Sensei, I bestow unto you this humble gift. May you partake so that we may {i}both{/i} get fucked up and free ourselves from the endless torment that is life itself.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我把这份微薄的礼物赐予你。愿你一同享用，好让我们{i}两个都{/i}烂掉，从「人生本身」这场无休止的折磨中解脱出来。

lines.en: : Well...that’s definitely a better alternative to unidentified medication, but I still don’t think getting drunk around someone so clearly under the influence is a great idea.
lines.zh: : 嗯……比起成分不明的药物，这确实是个更好的选择，但我还是觉得，在一个明显已经受影响的人身边喝醉不是什么好主意。

lines.en: scene iooutofit6
: Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because we wouldn’t be ourselves at that point.
lines.zh: : 因为到那时候我们就不是我们自己了。

lines.en: : If we’re not ourselves, anything that happens isn’t our fault.
lines.zh: : 如果我们不是我们自己，那发生的任何事都不是我们的错。

lines.en: : It would be more like whatever happens never happened in the first place.
lines.zh: : 更像是——反正发生的那些事从一开始就没发生过。

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Just accept the fucking gift, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 收下这份他妈的礼物就是了，Sensei。

lines.en: : With how uncertain the future is, {i}not{/i} accepting the gift could lead to Uta or I getting alcohol poisoning one day. And if that ever happened, I bet you’d regret not drinking right now.
lines.zh: : 未来这么不确定，{i}不{/i}收下这份礼物，说不定哪天 Uta 或我就会酒精中毒。要是真有那么一天，我敢打赌你会后悔现在没喝。

lines.en: : My bad. I didn’t realize I was supposed to be thinking ten steps ahead.
lines.zh: : 我的错。我不知道自己该往前想十步。

lines.en: scene iooutofit7
: Why {i}step{/i} at all when jumping is so much more fun?
lines.zh: : 既然跳过去有意思得多，干嘛还要{i}一步步走{/i}？

lines.en: scene black
Io scrambles to her feet and is able to set her chair back up without much of an issue.
lines.zh: Io 手脚并用地爬起来，没费多大劲就把椅子扶正了。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I just caught her at the height of her drug-induced stupor but, fortunately, it appears to be in the early stages of wearing off right now.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己是不是刚好撞上她药劲最足的时候，不过幸运的是，眼下似乎已经开始退了。

lines.en: She grabs her stepladder or, to paraphrase what she said just moments ago, the symbol of whether or not she is “really bad.”
lines.zh: 她抓起她的小梯子——或者用她刚才的话来说，那件象征她到底「糟不糟」的东西。

lines.en: In some ways, though, the Io today seems worse.
lines.zh: 不过从某些方面看，今天的 Io 似乎更糟。

lines.en: Sure, she isn’t feverish or struggling to walk, but she seems almost numb to the fact that she’s leaving herself open.
lines.zh: 当然，她没有发烧，走路也不费劲，可她对自己门户大开这件事，似乎几乎已经麻木了。

lines.en: I guess some might call that a good thing- that she’s comfortable enough with me to let her guard down in knowing that I won’t do anything to hurt her.
lines.zh: 我想有人会说这是好事——她跟我待在一起足够自在，才会卸下防备，因为她知道我不会做任何伤害她的事。

lines.en: It’s just worrying when she lets that guard down before {i}I{/i} do.
lines.zh: 只是，当她比{i}我{/i}先卸下防备时，就让人担心了。

lines.en: Because sometimes, I hurt people without even trying.
lines.zh: 因为有时候，我甚至不用刻意就会伤到人。

lines.en: Without even thinking about it.
lines.zh: 连想都没想过。

lines.en: And I do not want a reality where that becomes okay because the two of us decided to be someone else for a night.
lines.zh: 而我不希望出现那样一种现实：因为我们俩决定在今晚变成别人，那种事就变得可以接受了。

lines.en: scene iooutofit8
I am a marsh warbler.
lines.zh: 我是一只湿地苇莺。

lines.en: I abandon the me from minutes ago and slip into a new reality- one where I don’t feel the need to restrain myself in favor of protecting someone else because the center of this world is {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 我抛弃了几分钟前的那个自己，滑进一个新的现实——在那个现实里，我不必为了保护别人而约束自己，因为这个世界的中心是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: I am the one who needs to be protected. And the subsequent results of my decisions, while serving as occasional preventative measures, very rarely make things worse.
lines.zh: 需要被保护的人是我。而我那些决定带来的后果，虽然偶尔能起到预防作用，却很少把事情变得更糟。

lines.en: Things become worse on their own regardless of the choices I make or the things I do.
lines.zh: 不管我做什么选择、做什么事，事情自己就会变糟。

lines.en: There are consequences that we face without knowing or understanding what even invokes them at times.
lines.zh: 有些后果我们不得不面对，却连是什么招来的都不知道、不明白。

lines.en: If the world is going to break, I am not going to be the one to break it.
lines.zh: 如果世界要碎，我不会是那个把它弄碎的人。

lines.en: If Io is going to break, I am not going to be the one to break her.
lines.zh: 如果 Io 要碎，我不会是那个把她弄碎的人。

lines.en: Especially when she’s just like the wires and rods keeping my heart propped up- spread too thin to spread anymore.
lines.zh: 尤其是当她就像那些撑住我心脏的钢丝和支架——已经撑得太薄，再也撑不开了。

lines.en: And so immeasurably shattered from the get-go that her further destruction would be impossible.
lines.zh: 而且从一开始就碎得无法计量，再毁也不可能更毁了。

lines.en: I jumped not because I thought it would be more fun.
lines.zh: 我跳，不是因为我觉得那更有趣。

lines.en: I jumped because I knew it wouldn’t hurt me.
lines.zh: 我跳，是因为我知道那不会伤到我。

lines.en: : See! Aren’t you so much happier now that we’re {i}both{/i} not our normal selves?
lines.zh: : 看吧！{i}我们俩都{/i}不是平时的自己了，你是不是开心多了？

lines.en: : You seem more or less the same to me. Just a shade redder and...more animated with your hand movements.
lines.zh: : 我看着你差不多还是老样子。只是脸色更红了一点，还有……手的动作更夸张了。

lines.en: : Heheh. Yeah. The Clonazepam always makes my limbs feel a little numb, so that just kinda happens sometimes. Uta likes making fun of it.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿。是啊。氯硝西泮总让我的四肢有点发麻，所以有时候就会这样。Uta 喜欢拿这个取笑我。

lines.en: : I take it she sees you like this pretty often?
lines.zh: : 这么说她经常见到你这副样子？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. It’s like the only time I can kinda keep up with her, too. I think we both kind of enjoy it in a way.
lines.zh: : 哦，是啊。这大概也是我唯一能勉强跟上她的时候。我觉得我们俩在某种程度上都挺享受的。

lines.en: : She gets an Io who doesn’t complain about herself as much, and I get an Uta who...well, you know. It’s Uta. She’s always fun.
lines.zh: : 她得到一个不那么抱怨自己的 Io，而我得到一个……嗯，你知道的。就是 Uta。她永远都好玩。

lines.en: : Hey, what were you guys doing in the tea ceremony room thing the other day? That was weird.
lines.zh: : 嘿，前两天你们俩在那个茶室里干什么呢？那也太奇怪了。

lines.en: : I think it was something about me being sad.
lines.zh: : 我记得是跟我心情不好有关。

lines.en: : Were you actually sad? Do you wanna talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你真的难过吗？想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : No thanks. I can’t even really remember what it was about.
lines.zh: : 不用了。我连那到底是为了什么都记不清了。

lines.en: : Do you have depression, Sensei? I wouldn’t normally ask about something that directly because I hate when people do that for me, but this isn’t the {i}real{/i} Io speaking right now, so it’s cool if I do that.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有抑郁症吗？平时我不会问得这么直接，因为我讨厌别人这么问我；不过现在说话的不是{i}真正{/i}的 Io，所以我这么问也没关系。

lines.en: : No clue. It wouldn’t surprise me if I did, but it’s not something I think I really need to know.
lines.zh: : 没头绪。我要是真有也不意外，但我觉得这不是我真需要知道的事。

lines.en: : I mean, {i}I{/i} would wanna know if {i}I{/i} had depression.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果{i}我{/i}有抑郁症，{i}我{/i}会想知道的。

lines.en: : Do you...not?
lines.zh: : 你……不想？

lines.en: scene iooutofit9
: No! I don’t! That’s like, one of the only things I {i}don’t{/i} have! And it really pisses me off when people just {i}assume{/i} I have it because I don’t act how they {i}want{/i} me to, you know?!
lines.zh: : 不！我不需要！那差不多是我唯一{i}没有{/i}的毛病！而且人们就因为我的行为不合{i}他们的意{/i}，就随随便便{i}断定{/i}我有，真的把我气死了，你知道吗？！

lines.en: : Kirin asked me the same shit the other day and then started rattling off all this stuff about psychology like she actually {i}knew{/i} what she was talking about and I almost turned her into an art project!
lines.zh: : Kirin 前两天也问了我一模一样的狗屁问题，然后开始噼里啪啦甩一堆心理学名词，搞得好像她{i}真懂{/i}似的——我差点把她变成一个手工作品！

lines.en: scene iooutofit10

: Now, asking if I take drugs that {i}treat{/i} depression is another story entirely since the usage of antidepressants extends far beyond depressive disorder, but do I actually have {i}depression?{/i} Fuck no!
lines.zh: : 当然，问我是不是在吃{i}治{/i}抑郁的药完全是另一回事——毕竟抗抑郁药的用途远远不止抑郁症——可我真的有{i}抑郁症{/i}吗？他妈的没有！

lines.en: scene iooutofit11
: You’d think that shit with that disorder was annoying enough in the fact that everybody and their mother claims to have it now-
lines.zh: : 你会以为，那种病已经够烦人了——现在所有人都说自己有，连他妈的七大姑八大姨都算上——

lines.en: : But the fact that it’s extended to the point where undiagnosed people are diagnosing {i}other{/i} people with it despite having zero understanding of how it works is just straight up ridiculous!
lines.zh: : 可现在居然发展到——一群压根没被诊断过的人，在完全不懂它机制的情况下给{i}别人{/i}下诊断——这简直荒唐到家了！

lines.en: scene iooutofit12
: Anyway, rant over. I’ve been holding that in for a while and it felt good to let it out, so thanks. Even {i}if{/i} you just did the exact thing that I was complaining about.
lines.zh: : 总之，牢骚发完了。这番话我憋了一阵子，说出来真舒服，谢啦。{i}尽管{/i}你刚才做的正是我抱怨的那件事。

lines.en: : Yeah...now I know for next time, I guess.
lines.zh: : 是啊……那我下次就知道了，大概。

lines.en: : If you don’t mind me asking, though, exactly what {i}are{/i} all of these medications for then? Besides anxiety, which I think everybody already knows about.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你不介意我问的话，这堆药到底{i}是{/i}治什么的？除了焦虑——那个我想大家早就知道了。

lines.en: scene iooutofit13
: Honestly? I don’t even know what they’re trying to treat with some of them. I’m at the point where I just take whatever’s given to me without questioning it and watch as it fucks me up later.
lines.zh: : 说实话？有些药我连它们想治什么都不清楚。我已经到了这个地步：给我什么我就吃什么，不问，然后看着它事后把我搞得一团糟。

lines.en: : That...is extremely worrying.
lines.zh: : 那……实在让人非常担心。

lines.en: : Worried my aunt at first too. In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if it still worries her now. She just doesn’t let it show anymore.
lines.zh: : 一开始也把我姑姑吓得够呛。事实上，就算她现在还在担心，我也不会意外。她只是不再表现出来了。

lines.en: : It’s obviously not like that for all of them, though. Some of this stuff I’ve been taking for, like...I don’t know, seven or eight years?
lines.zh: : 不过显然也不是所有药都这样。有些我已经吃了……我不知道，大概七八年了吧？

lines.en: : I just got to a point where I accepted that everything about me is broken and that some of it can be patched up by the shit they shove into orange bottles.
lines.zh: : 我只是到了一个地步：接受了自己浑身上下都是坏的，而其中一部分，可以靠他们塞进橙色药瓶里的那些狗屁东西补一补。

lines.en: scene iooutofit14
: Hey, it can’t be {i}everything{/i} if you don’t have depression, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要是没有抑郁症，那就不可能是「{i}全都坏{/i}」了吧？

lines.en: : That’s a good point. The TLDR is that there’s a lot of me that hasn’t worked the way it’s supposed to since I was little.
lines.zh: : 有道理。长话短说就是：我身上有很多地方，从我很小的时候起就没按应有的方式运作过。

lines.en: : TLDR?
lines.zh: : 长话短说？

lines.en: : Too long, didn’t read. You’re old.
lines.zh: : 「太长不看」的缩写。你老了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Io.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Io。

lines.en: : No, like really old. The cap is still on that bottle. And your glass is full.
lines.zh: : 不，是真的老。瓶盖还拧着呢。你的杯子还是满的。

lines.en: : You don’t have any pills in here that treat dementia, do you?
lines.zh: : 你这儿没有治痴呆的药吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. But the clinic I get my Ketamine from is open 24 hours and I can probably cash in a few of my broken girl punch-cards in exchange for a couple free doses.
lines.zh: : 应该没有。不过我拿氯胺酮的那家诊所 24 小时营业，我大概能用几张「坏女孩集点卡」换几次免费的剂量。

lines.en: : I don’t think it helps with dementia, but it feels cool.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它对痴呆没帮助，但嗑起来挺爽的。

lines.en: : I think I’m just...more drunk than I thought.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是……比我以为的醉得厉害。

lines.en: : I bet. I’ve only had sake a couple times, but I remember it being super strong and messing me up like, right away.
lines.zh: : 我猜也是。清酒我只喝过几次，但我记得它劲特别大，一下就把我放倒了。

lines.en: : Considering that this bottle is probably heavier than you, I’m not surprised.
lines.zh: : 考虑到这瓶酒大概比你人还重，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Can I try?
lines.zh: : 我能尝尝吗？

lines.en: scene iooutofit15
: Aren’t you on like eight hundred medications? There’s no way mixing alcohol with them would be a good idea.
lines.zh: : 你不是吃着大概八百种药吗？把它们和酒混在一起，绝对不可能是什么好主意。

lines.en: : Nothing about tonight has been a good idea by most accounts. Plus, I’ve been watching you drink from that glass all night and I want to ham up the indirect kiss cliche.
lines.zh: : 按大多数人的标准，今晚就没一件事是好主意。再说，我看着你喝那杯酒看了一整晚，我想把「间接接吻」这个老套桥段演足。

lines.en: : Okay. But I’m only agreeing to this because I’m also intoxicated and, if you actually die, I’m going to run away with Uta just to spite you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过我答应，只是因为我也醉了；要是你真死了，我就跟 Uta 私奔，纯粹是为了气你。

lines.en: scene iooutofit16
: You say that like it would be a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得，好像那是件坏事似的。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 难道不是吗？

lines.en: : You and Uta? Not really. If that made you guys happy, I probably wouldn’t even mind dying.
lines.zh: : 你和 Uta？也不算。要是那样能让你们幸福，我大概连死都不在乎。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’m having too much fun right now to actually die.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我现在玩得太开心了，死不了。

lines.en: : I’m just saying that the two people who matter most to me finding joy in the arms of one another wouldn’t ever be {i}bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，对我来说最重要的两个人，能在彼此的怀抱里找到快乐，那永远都不会是{i}坏{/i}事。

lines.en: : I just wish it could be me in your arms instead.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，在你怀里的是我就好了。

lines.en: scene iooutofit17
scene iooutofit18
: Geh...
: This never happened.
lines.zh: : 这事没发生过。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : That stuff...really is strong, huh?
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿……劲真大啊。

lines.en: : Did you enjoy it at least?
lines.zh: : 至少你还享受吧？

lines.en: scene iooutofit19
: Yeah...
: I got to taste your lips.
lines.zh: : 我尝到你的嘴唇了。

lines.en: scene black
scene iooutofit20
I turn off the lights and rest Io on the bed after she finally passes out.
lines.zh: Io 终于昏睡过去之后，我关了灯，把她安顿在床上。

lines.en: But before you blame me, I didn’t let her have any more alcohol after that.
lines.zh: 不过在你们怪我之前——那之后我没再让她喝过酒了。

lines.en: Does that absolve me of the fact that I let her have some in the first place? No.
lines.zh: 这能不能开脱我一开始让她喝过的事实？不能。

lines.en: But it’s something she would have done on her own the moment I left either way. Being able to watch over her as it happens is surely better than the alternative, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 可不管怎样，我一走她自己也会这么干。能在事情发生时看着她，总比另一种情况好吧？

lines.en: Like I said before, things are going to happen whether I want them to or not.
lines.zh: 就像我之前说的，不管我想不想，事情都会发生。

lines.en: scene black
Which is why, despite knowing that I am the last thing she needs, I want to keep seeing her.
lines.zh: 所以，尽管我知道自己正是她最不需要的东西，我还是想继续见她。

lines.en: I want to taste her lips as well.
lines.zh: 我也想尝尝她的嘴唇。
